Common state variables and polynomial physics establish the relationship; print transcription and exact intermediate edition are not verified. source_research.finding: The full original FOCAL listing is downloaded unchanged from Jim Storer’s own history archive, which credits Matthew House’s transcription. This is the first canonical source commit, ll-storer1969. A complete electronic transcription of published BASIC Lunar follows as ll-basic1978, before untouched tape9a save 9 at ll-v01. The original FOCAL, published BASIC, and recovered adaptation share state variables and polynomial physics. The exact intermediate BASIC edition used by Carl is unknown. The recovered record 1710 omits the published branch’s GOSUB physics call; the position polynomial also lacks the final Q^5 term. Do not claim numerical identity or repair those differences.

website_execution.checks_and_limits: Original-ROM checks passed for tape9a save 9: NO at instructions; 0,10 advances the free fall and plotted point; 0,120 reaches impact at 113.553 seconds and 4008.79 mph; 75,10 after restart leaves 15750 pounds of fuel. Pause/resume and restart passed. No successful soft landing, upward-motion branch, or exhaustive physics parity is claimed. Upstream FOCAL and published BASIC baselines were not executed.
